children: New Delhi, Oct. 19 -- Hindustan Zinc, Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA), L&T Technology Services Limited, Union Bank of India, Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited, Bajaj Finance, and Aerpace Industries are among the 35 companies will announce their second quarter earnings on Monday, October 19.

Meanwhile, Indian stock market is likely to remain volatile, after seeing sharp rally over the last week. Nifty 50 has surged 2.49%, whereas BSE Sensex has jumped nearly 3.30% over the past five trading sessions.
As investors will closely track earnings for the quarter ended in September, here are all the details about Q2 results 2026 scheduled for today.

Bajaj Finance, Bhansali Engineering Polymers, Gallant Ispat Limited, Hindustan Zinc, HFCL, Modern Steels Limited, UltraTech Cement, Waaree Renewable Technologies, etc will announce their Q2FY27 results on Monday, October 19. Check full list below.

The Indian benchmark indices logged their second consecutive week of gains, with Nifty and Sensex staging a sharp recovery above their vital short-term moving averages with settling the week at 23,146 and 74,729. The sharp rally in the Indian stock market was driven by in-line IT sector earnings, rally in tech stocks post sell-off in international AI and semiconductor stocks, cooling US Treasury bond yields, etc.

"Nifty has rebounded sharply from its 200-week EMA and ascending trendline support near 22200, gaining 2.78% this week following the recent correction. The index has established a strong base on the daily chart and reclaimed its 21-day EMA near 22900, signalling improving momentum. As long as Nifty sustains above this level, buying interest is likely to persist, making a buy-on-dips strategy prudent.

On the upside, the 55-day EMA near 23360 remains the immediate resistance. A decisive breakout above this hurdle could strengthen the recovery and trigger further buying momentum, opening the door for an upside move towards 23600," stated Dr. Ravi Singh, Chief Research Officer from Master Capital Services Ltd.
